title: Firebase Admin SDK service account private key committed in git history (commit dea0862)
impact: Although removed from HEAD in commit 65737a2, the full RSA private key for firebase-adminsdk-p19st@scorpio-srs.iam.gserviceaccount.com remains in git history and grants administrative access to Firestore, Firebase Auth, and Storage unless revoked in GCP IAM.
recommendation: Immediately delete/revoke service account key 0fb14b518c229ed6e15e7f128ad8e4e6e6e8dd82 in Google Cloud Console -> IAM & Admin -> Service Accounts and purge commit dea0862 from git history via git-filter-repo.

title: Missing rate limits on 25 of 29 API routes and spoofable IP/visitorId on /api/chat/landing
impact: Unthrottled AI routes (/api/student/tutor, /api/ai/parse, /api/ai/synthesize-rubric, /api/grade, /api/teacher/network/portfolio) allow rapid budget exhaustion, code-validation routes allow brute-forcing teacher/invite codes, and /api/chat/landing trusts spoofable x-forwarded-for and visitorId values to charge LANDING_ORG_ID.
recommendation: Apply Firestore-backed rate limiting keyed by verified uid across all AI and code-validation routes, and use platform-verified client IP + server-signed visitor cookies on /api/chat/landing.

title: Admin endpoints authenticate solely via static x-admin-secret header without user identity, constant-time comparison, or audit logging
impact: /api/admin/firestore, /api/auth/request-access, /api/auth/teacher-code, and /api/research/respond grant read/write/delete access to sensitive Firestore collections using a single shared secret compared with !== and no per-user accountability.
recommendation: Require verifyAuth(req) with a verified admin custom claim (or crypto.timingSafeEqual on server-to-server secrets), restrict /api/admin/firestore collections to an allowlist, and write audit logs to admin_audit_logs.

title: Unvalidated request body spread (...data) in POST /api/assignments and zero Zod schema enforcement across all 29 API routes
impact: Any authenticated teacher can inject arbitrary fields into Firestore assignments documents via { ...data }, and malformed nested payloads across API routes can corrupt state or trigger unhandled 500 errors.
recommendation: Define strict Zod schemas for all API route bodies and query parameters, and explicitly pick allowed Assignment fields instead of spreading ...data.

title: Reachable Critical and High CVEs in next@16.2.1, @tiptap/core@<=3.30.4, prosemirror-view@<1.42.3, and protobufjs@<=7.6.4
impact: Next.js 16.2.1 is vulnerable to Middleware/Proxy bypass and RSC DoS/cache poisoning; prosemirror-view and @tiptap/core are vulnerable to paste XSS (GHSA-c8x8-7fp4-3x9w) and __proto__ DOM attribute injection (GHSA-cp6q-959q-f8rh) in RichTextEditor; protobufjs is used by firebase-admin/Firestore.
recommendation: Upgrade next to ^16.4.6, @tiptap/* to >=3.30.5 (with prosemirror-view >=1.42.3), protobufjs to >=7.6.5, and remove unused root vercel and sib-api-v3-sdk packages.

title: DELETE /api/auth/session neither validates Origin nor revokes Firebase session tokens server-side
impact: Logging out only deletes the browser __session cookie while leaving any captured 5-day session cookie valid until natural expiration, and lacks Origin verification against cross-site logout CSRF.
recommendation: Verify the Origin header on POST/DELETE /api/auth/session and call adminAuth.verifySessionCookie followed by adminAuth.revokeRefreshTokens(decodedClaims.sub) on logout.

title: Missing HTTP security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy)
impact: Neither next.config.mjs nor firebase.json configures security response headers, leaving the app without clickjacking protection, MIME-sniffing protection, or Content-Security-Policy defense-in-depth.
recommendation: Add an async headers() configuration in next.config.mjs (and matching headers in firebase.json) setting X-Frame-Options: DENY, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, Referrer-Policy: strict-origin-when-cross-origin, Strict-Transport-Security, Permissions-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy.

title: Incomplete PII scrubbing before Gemini calls (6 of 10 AI routes omit scrubPII) and plaintext student email logging in Cloud Functions
impact: Student names, emails, and IDs in /api/tutor, /api/student/tutor, /api/chat, /api/ai/parse, /api/ai/generate, /api/ai/synthesize-rubric, and peer names in /api/teacher/network/portfolio are sent to Gemini unredacted, and student emails are logged to stdout in functions/src/index.ts:L108 and functions/src/lib/email.ts:L34,L37.
recommendation: Centralize scrubPII() inside generateContentWithTrack() in src/lib/ai/config.ts, redact all student names in portfolio synthesis, and mask email addresses in server/Cloud Function logs.

title: Verbose upstream error payloads, raw error.message/stack responses, and uncached GITHUB_TOKEN API calls
impact: 16 API routes return raw err.message or upstream error bodies (including polarError.body and err.stack in /api/auth/teacher-code:L132), and force-dynamic in /api/github/stats:L3 defeats revalidate=3600 so every page load burns authenticated GitHub API quota.
recommendation: Return generic client error messages while logging details server-side, remove err.stack from responses, and remove export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic' from /api/github/stats/route.ts.

title: Unsanitized Showdown Markdown-to-HTML conversion passed into TipTap RichTextEditor
impact: new Showdown.Converter().makeHtml(md) passes raw HTML directly to RichTextEditor without DOMPurify sanitization, amplifying DOM XSS risk when combined with prosemirror-view/TipTap advisories or raw HTML in AI/user markdown.
recommendation: Sanitize Showdown output with isomorphic-dompurify before passing to RichTextEditor or parse markdown directly into TipTap JSON nodes.

title: Personal resume PDF, high-resolution headshot, and internal planning/outdated screenshots exposed in public/
impact: public/Rushil_Mahadevu_Resume_2026.pdf exposes personal contact details at a public URL, and public/headshot-sage.jpg (3.1 MB), public/plan.jpg (1.2 MB), and public/mission-control(outdated).png (1.3 MB) ship unnecessary personal/internal assets.
recommendation: Remove Rushil_Mahadevu_Resume_2026.pdf, plan.jpg, and mission-control(outdated).png from public/ and compress remaining public images to WebP.
